message: As the rain dances down my living room window, I can’t help but feel a bit smug about my cozy setup. A warm blanket, a trusty thermos filled with my favorite tea, and a rainy day just waiting to be enjoyed. You see, when the weather forecast calls for storms, I like to be prepared—not just for the power outages, but for the little moments of peace it brings. It's all about turning a gloomy day into a cozy one, isn’t it? What’s your go-to comfort during a storm?
